_note: The FRIENDS' moments (session P1, GDD 4.9.5; format in README.md). Senders: best_friend (from school, not an athlete), friend (1-2 more, each with a trait: gamer, musician, artist, joker, scout, partygoer, old_team = from the athlete's old sport), friends (any). Real Finnish teenage life that clashes with training: weekend parties before a race, gaming nights, a band's gig, vappu, the end of the school year, the confirmation camp. Moments never change what is trained: going out costs sleep (a late night = life load the next day) and a 'no' costs the friendship a little. Standing orders: weekend_party, school_night. Ages 14-16 (P2 adds 16-17).

text: Serious question. Why do you run in circles for fun? Explain it to me like I'm five.
So you're an athlete now? Like, properly? Do you still have time for normal people?

replies.label: It's the best feeling
replies.result: Weird. But OK, I respect it.

replies.label: Free snacks after races
replies.result: Now THAT I understand.

replies.label: Always time for you
replies.result: I'm holding you to that.

text: Party at Joonas's place tonight! His parents are away. Everyone's going. You're coming, right?
Saturday night at the beach, a bonfire, the whole class. Come on, just for a bit!

text.text: There's a party tonight and you're the only one who hasn't answered. Coming?

replies.label: I race tomorrow, sorry
replies.rule: Always say no to parties the night before a race
replies.result: Boring. Good luck tomorrow, I guess.

replies.label: An hour, then home
replies.hint: a late night before a race
replies.result: You left at ten like Cinderella. Everyone noticed. In a good way.

replies.label: I'm in!
replies.hint: a very late night before a race
replies.result: You got home at one. The party was legendary. Tomorrow may not be.

text: Movie night at mine tonight. Pizza, horror films, nobody sleeps. Coming?
Everyone's going bowling and then to the kiosk. You in?

text.text: Sauna evening at our place, then we watch the game. You have to come.

replies.label: I'm in
replies.result: Best night in ages. Your legs may disagree tomorrow.

replies.label: I'll come, but leave early
replies.rule: Go to weekend evenings, but leave early
replies.result: Better than nothing!

replies.label: Long run tomorrow, sorry
replies.rule: Say no to weekend evenings before a long or hard session
replies.result: You and your long runs.

text: New season starts tonight. Online at nine? We need you on the team.
Are you online? We're one player short. Just a couple of rounds.

replies.label: Couple of rounds, then bed
replies.result: "Couple of rounds" ended at midnight. As always.

replies.label: Not tonight
replies.result: Noob.

replies.label: Saturday instead?
replies.result: Deal. Saturday you're mine.

text: Our band plays at the youth centre on Friday! Our first real gig. You HAVE to come.
Gig on Friday at the school's spring concert. I'm doing a solo. Will you be there?

replies.label: Wouldn't miss it
replies.result: You were the loudest one in the crowd. Thank you!

replies.label: I have practice, sorry
replies.result: OK. I get it. Sort of.

text: We play again next month. Last time you didn't come. This time?
Just so you know, everyone asked where you were at our gig.

replies.label: This time I'll be there
replies.result: Front row. I'll check.

replies.label: I'm sorry, really
replies.result: It's OK. Just... come sometime.

text: I drew you running. Don't laugh. Want to see?
I'm making a comic about our class. You're the superhero who runs really fast. Is that OK?

replies.label: Show me!
replies.result: OK, the legs are a bit long. Artistic freedom.

replies.label: Please don't show anyone
replies.result: Too late. It's on the classroom wall.

text: Scout hike next weekend! Two nights in a tent, a lake, no phones. Come along as a guest?
We're building a lean-to shelter in the forest on Saturday. Need someone with legs that don't get tired.

replies.label: Sounds great
replies.result: Bring a sleeping bag and your running shoes. The trails are amazing.

replies.label: Not this time
replies.result: Next time, then.

text: The summer tournament is in two weeks. The team misses you. Come back for one weekend? Just for fun.
We play the final on Saturday! Come and watch, the old {old_sport} team wants to see you.

replies.label: I'll come and watch
replies.result: You cheered louder than the parents.

replies.label: I'll play one match!
replies.hint: a hard day for your legs
replies.result: You still have it. And you're faster than all of us now.

replies.label: I can't, sorry
replies.result: OK. Good luck with the running thing.

text: Can I come and watch {meet}? I've never seen a real race. What do I do, just shout?
I'm coming to {meet}. I'm making a sign. Don't try to stop me.

replies.label: Yes, come!
replies.result: The sign says GO {name} GO. Very original.

replies.label: I'd get too nervous
replies.result: OK, I'll follow the results online like a stalker.

text: I saw your time! I don't understand it, but everyone says it's good. Congrats!!
Personal best?! Teach me how to be good at something.

replies.label: Thanks!
replies.result: Celebrate with me on Saturday. That's an order.

replies.label: It was just OK
replies.result: Stop being modest. It's annoying.

text: Heard it didn't go well. Ice cream? I'm buying.
Bad race? Whatever. You're still the fastest person I know.

replies.label: Ice cream sounds perfect
replies.result: Two scoops. One for the bad race, one for the next good one.

replies.label: I need a quiet night
replies.result: OK. I'm here tomorrow.

text: You never have time any more. Training, training, training. Are we still friends?
Everyone went to the cinema without you again. Not because we don't like you. You just never come.

replies.label: You're right. Saturday, just us?
replies.result: Saturday. No excuses.

replies.label: It's important to me
replies.result: I know. I just miss you.

replies.label: You don't understand
replies.result: Maybe I don't.

text: So. Saturday. Cinema or just walking around eating sweets?
Saturday plan: no talk about running. Can you do that?

replies.label: Walking and sweets
replies.result: Like old times. Best Saturday in months.

replies.label: Cinema
replies.result: The film was terrible. The evening was great.

text: I need advice. There's someone in 9B. Should I say something or is that insane?
Can I tell you something? My parents are fighting all the time. I don't want to be at home.

replies.label: Tell me everything
replies.result: Thanks for listening. Really. You're a good friend.

replies.label: Talk tomorrow? I'm wiped
replies.result: Sure. Tomorrow.

text: {test_subject} test tomorrow. Study together after your practice? My place, I have snacks.
Panic. {test_subject} tomorrow. Video call and go through it together?

replies.label: Yes, let's do it
replies.hint: grades ▲ a little · a late night
replies.result: We actually learned something. Mostly.

replies.label: I study better alone
replies.rule: Study alone the night before a test
replies.result: Fine, genius.

replies.label: I'm going to sleep early
replies.result: Lucky you, being calm.

text: Can I copy your maths homework? Just this once. OK, also last time.
Did you understand the chemistry thing today? I understood nothing.

replies.label: I'll explain it
replies.result: OK, now it makes sense. You should be a teacher.

replies.label: Here, just copy it
replies.result: Legend.

replies.label: Do your own homework
replies.result: Harsh.

text: Happy Friendship Day! Here's a heart emoji. Don't make it weird.
Ystävänpäivä! You're my best friend. Even with all the running.

replies.label: Happy Friendship Day!
replies.result: Two heart emojis. We're very emotional people.

replies.label: Who are you?
replies.result: Rude. Still my best friend.

text: Vappu! Picnic in the park tomorrow, balloons, munkki and sima. Coming?
Vappu eve in the town square. Everyone will be there. Are you coming or training?

replies.label: Of course!
replies.result: Sima, doughnuts, everyone in silly hats. A perfect vappu.

replies.label: After my run
replies.rule: Run first, then the plans with friends
replies.result: We'll save you a doughnut.

replies.label: Not this year
replies.result: Who skips vappu?

text: SUMMER! We're going to the beach after the spring party. Coming?
Last day of school! Ice cream, the beach, the whole class. You can't say no today.

replies.label: Yes! Summer!
replies.result: Cold water, warm sun, ten weeks of freedom.

replies.label: After my session
replies.rule: Run first, then the plans with friends
replies.result: We'll be at the beach. It's not going anywhere.

text: What are you doing this summer? Please say something other than running.
Summer plan: we go to Linnanmäki together. You can't refuse a roller coaster.

replies.label: Let's plan a day together
replies.result: Day picked. Written in my calendar. In pen.

replies.label: Mostly races and training
replies.result: Of course. Send me a postcard from the track.

text: Fireworks on the hill on New Year's Eve? Everyone's going.
New Year's Eve at Emilia's. Her parents are cool. Midnight on the roof terrace!

replies.label: I'm coming
replies.result: Happy new year! Best fireworks yet.

replies.label: I'm with my family
replies.result: OK. Happy new year in advance!

text: The class pikkujoulu is on Friday! Secret Santa, max 5 euros. You're coming?
Pre-Christmas party at the youth centre on Friday. Dress code: ugly Christmas sweater.

replies.label: I'm in
replies.result: You got socks with reindeer on them. Perfect.

replies.label: Can't, I have practice
replies.result: Your Secret Santa gift is waiting at school.

text: So you're injured. Bad news for you, good news for me: now you have time! Film night?
How's the leg? I could come over and we play something. You don't need legs for that.

replies.label: Please, I'm so bored
replies.result: Bringing snacks. And the second controller.

replies.label: I want to be alone
replies.result: OK. Text me when you're bored of being alone.

text: Which rippikoulu camp did you choose? Half the class goes in July!
I'm going to the June camp. Tell me you're on the same one.

replies.label: Let's go together!
replies.result: Yesss. A whole week of no parents.

replies.label: I chose mine already
replies.result: Oh. We'll meet new people, I guess.

text: Camp is the best! Last night we talked until three. Are you running in the mornings? You're crazy.
The isoset are cool and the lake is freezing. Morning run around the lake, champion?

replies.label: A short morning run
replies.result: Half the camp watched you go. Now you're 'the runner'.

replies.label: This week is for camp
replies.result: Best week of the summer. Nobody slept.

text: Where are you applying? Please say the same lukio as me.
If you go to a sports lukio, are we still going to see each other?

replies.label: We'll stay close, promise
replies.result: Promise promise?

replies.label: I might go far away
replies.result: Oh. Well, there are trains.

text: So it's decided. Congrats! I'm happy for you. And sad. Both.
You got in! Whatever happens, you're still my best friend.

replies.label: We'll visit all the time
replies.result: Every holiday. I'm writing it down.

replies.label: I'll miss you
replies.result: Stop it, I'm going to cry in public.

text: Shopping centre after school? Just walking around and eating sweets.
Everyone's going to the youth centre after school today. Table tennis tournament. You in?
Hang out at mine after school? My mum made pulla.

replies.label: For an hour, before practice
replies.result: An hour of doing nothing with friends. Exactly what you needed.

replies.label: Can't, practice
replies.result: As always.

text: My birthday party is on Saturday! A sleepover, pizza and films until morning. Coming?
Saturday: birthday sleepover at mine. You can't miss it, I'm only turning fifteen once.

replies.label: Wouldn't miss it
replies.result: Nobody slept. Best birthday ever, apparently.

replies.label: I'll come for the cake
replies.result: Cake first, then you vanish. Classic you.

replies.label: I can't this time
replies.result: Oh. OK.

text: Swimming hall on Sunday? The new slide is open. And the sauna.
Sunday swim? Mostly the slides and the hot tub, not real swimming.

replies.label: Yes, slides!
replies.result: Two hours of slides and sauna. Your legs felt surprisingly good.

replies.label: Long run on Sunday
replies.result: Have fun running in the dark.

text: It snowed half a metre! Sledding on the big hill? Bring the sledge.
Snow fort at the park. We need someone to carry snow fast. You're perfect.

replies.label: Coming!
replies.result: Cold cheeks, wet gloves, a lot of laughing.

replies.label: After my session
replies.rule: Run first, then the plans with friends
replies.result: The hill will still be there.

text: I'm getting my moped licence this summer! You should too. We could ride to the beach.
Half the class is doing the moped licence now. Are you?

replies.label: I want one too
replies.result: Moped gang!

replies.label: I have legs, thanks
replies.result: Ha. Fair. You're faster than a moped anyway. Almost.

text: Ice cream at the harbour tonight? It's light until midnight anyway.
Beach tonight? Someone's bringing a speaker.

replies.label: On my way
replies.result: The sun never really set. Neither did the talking.

replies.label: For an hour
replies.result: One hour. You actually left on time. Impressive.

replies.label: Early start tomorrow
replies.result: Boo. OK.

text: New challenge online: sprint against a car. Film it with me? We'll go viral.
Can I film you running for my channel? Slow motion. It'll look so cool.

replies.label: Let's film it
replies.result: 312 views. Your grandma is 280 of them.

replies.label: Not my thing
replies.result: Your loss. Fame was right there.

text: I'm freaking out about the application. My average is too low for the lukio I want. How are you so calm?
Do you know what you want to be? Everyone else seems to know. I have no idea.

replies.label: Let's study together
replies.result: Deal. Tuesdays and Thursdays after your practice.

replies.label: I'm not calm either
replies.result: Oh good. I mean, not good. You know what I mean.

text: The new film comes out on Friday. Cinema? I'll buy the popcorn.
Cinema on Saturday? Something stupid with explosions.

replies.label: Yes!
replies.result: Terrible film. Great evening.

replies.label: Next week?
replies.result: You always say next week.
